Package com.bdtripp.hauntedhouse.model

Class World

java.lang.Object
com.bdtripp.hauntedhouse.model.World
public class World extends Object
Stores all of the things that exist in the game world such as the player, the rooms of the haunted house, the items in the rooms, etc.
